MLB01 every method is shown by its governed name
MET01 values render by their governed unit
MET02 breakdown bars sort, keep the raw value and drop nulls
MET03 a trend draws one line per book
MET04 only grid columns drill to rows
NAV01 safeBack keeps same-origin paths only
NAV02 withBack appends an encoded origin and never an unsafe one
NAV03 backLabel names the origin module
SCN01 only overlaps still needing a decision are pending
SCN02 a blank choice is never defaulted into a resolution
SCN03 readiness tones never show a blocked scenario as ready
SCN04 the component matrix names each carried component's source
SCN05 derived macro rows keep the sign and the governed slope
SCN06 the band figure plots the server's band mix, one bar per band
SCN07 builder offers ratings only to Corporate and scores only to Retail
TRC01 snapshot names are safe file stems the server accepts
TRC02 hashes are shortened for display but never invented
WIF01 a chart click adds its value as an `in` filter, a second click removes it
WIF02 cross-filter keeps every other column's filter untouched
WIF03 a box/lasso selection replaces that column's values; empty clears it
WIF04 numeric categories (stage) match regardless of string/number form
WIF05 each book offers its own governed dimensions, never the other's
WIF06 a heatmap cell or flow link narrows to both coordinates; the same click clears them
